exportGuide.title: How to export your WhatsApp chat?
iosSteps: Open WhatsApp and go to the chat you want to export
Tap on the chat name at the top
Select how you want to share the file (Email, iCloud Drive, etc.)
Select your file and follow the prompts to export
Share the exported .txt file with WhatsApp Wrapped
androidSteps: Open WhatsApp and long-press on the chat you want to export
Select how you want to share the file
Share the exported .txt file with WhatsApp Wrapped
